solve_ik_with_position_constraints: solve an inverse kinematics problem using position constraints and limit error functions for a character
solve_ik_with_projection_constraints: solve IK with vertex projection constraints to match 2D screen-space target positions
compute_gradient: compute the gradient of the IK error function given position and motion constraints
compute_residual_and_jacobian: compute the residual vector and jacobian matrix for the current model parameters and constraints
transform_pose: transform a character pose by a given transformation matrix and return updated model parameters
